name: Cytisine
aliases: sophorin, baptitoxin, baptitoxine, Baptitoxine, cytisin, laburnin, sophorine, Sophorine
summary: Cytisine, also known as baptitoxine, cytisinicline, or sophorine, is an alkaloid that occurs naturally in several plant genera, such as Laburnum and Cytisus of the family Fabaceae. It was first reported in 1865 and has been used medically to help with smoking cessation.

uses.text: It was first reported in 1865 and has been used medically to help with smoking cessation. It has also been used entheogenically via mescalbeans by some Native American groups, historically in the Rio Grande Valley predating even peyote. Cytisine is on the World Health Organization's List of Essential Medicines.
uses.recreational: Plants containing cytisine, including the scotch broom and mescalbean, have also been used recreationally. Positive effects are reported to include a nicotine-like intoxication.

zhOther: 金雀兒鹼, 金雀花鹼
summaryZh: 野靛鹼，又稱金雀花鹼，是一種生物鹼，化學式為C11H14N2O，存在於毒豆屬、金雀兒屬等豆科植物中，常用於戒煙。

pharmacology.en: It is a partial agonist at nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, especially the type that nicotine acts on most in the brain. It partly activates them, easing cravings, while blunting the reward from nicotine.
pharmacology.zh: 它是菸鹼型乙醯膽鹼受體的部分促效劑，尤其是大腦中尼古丁作用最強的那一型。它會部分活化這些受體以緩解渴求，同時削弱尼古丁帶來的獎賞感。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体的部分促效剂，尤其是大脑中尼古丁作用最强的那一型。它会部分活化这些受体以缓解渴求，同时削弱尼古丁带来的奖赏感。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include nausea, stomach upset, dry mouth, headache, sleep problems and unusual dreams. Poisoning, as from eating laburnum seeds, causes vomiting, sweating, a fast heartbeat, and in severe cases seizures and trouble breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括噁心、腸胃不適、口乾、頭痛、睡眠問題與奇怪的夢。中毒時，例如誤食金鏈花種子，會造成嘔吐、出汗、心跳加快，嚴重時可能出現癲癇發作與呼吸困難。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括恶心、肠胃不适、口干、头痛、睡眠问题与奇怪的梦。中毒时，例如误食金链花种子，会造成呕吐、出汗、心跳加快，严重时可能出现癫痫发作与呼吸困难。

fact.en: Cytisine has been sold in Bulgaria as a stop-smoking aid since the 1960s. Its shape inspired the design of varenicline, the stop-smoking drug sold as Champix and Chantix.
fact.zh: 野靛鹼自 1960 年代起就在保加利亞作為戒菸輔助藥販售。它的結構也啟發了戒菸藥伐尼克蘭（商品名 Champix、Chantix）的設計。
fact.zhHans: 野靛碱自 1960 年代起就在保加利亚作为戒烟辅助药贩售。它的结构也启发了戒烟药伐尼克兰（商品名 Champix、Chantix）的设计。
